description: The options' brightness screen: one row per value; Up/Down picks a row, Left/Right changes it. kind percent: a float setting shown as a percentage; kind level: an integer level. brightness, contrast and saturation are the PC output stage (the whole frame); classic_level is the original game's brightness 0..7. Labels are padded with '_' to equal drawn width so the values line up. Positions are in percent of the screen; arrows are relative to the selected row. Every key is checked: an unknown key is an error.
